title: Mysterious Helper
next_chapter_hook: The moment the black-clad figure dissolved into scattered light, the lingering warmth in Chen Ji's palm was slowly fading. And that sentence, 'Tomorrow at noon, you will see him,' was like a silver needle piercing into his marrow, making him toss and turn all night—would the one about to appear be friend or foe?

text.content:
As the darkness receded like a tide, Chen Ji's consciousness gradually cleared, yet he found himself standing in a chaotic void. He wanted to move, but discovered his limbs seemed bound by invisible chains, only his eyeballs able to turn slowly. What entered his vision was that black cloth mask right before his eyes—the mysterious figure's presence was so close it nearly touched his face, and a musty yet familiar sandalwood scent entered his nose, causing his heart to tighten abruptly.

This fragrance... why does it feel so familiar?

Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, his mind racing. Someone who could appear silently in the depths of Tianqing Sect's dungeon, and address him with such an overbearing attitude, was definitely no ordinary person. And that 'brother' was like a heavy hammer, striking the psychological defenses he had carefully constructed over many years.

dialogue.content: "What, scared?" The black-clad figure's voice was hoarse and low, carrying a hint of mockery. "That Tianji Record aura on you, I could smell it from ten miles away. Chen family's whelp, quite bold indeed, daring to touch that forbidden object."

text.content:
Chen Ji's heart tightened, but his expression remained composed. He slowly mobilized his meager spiritual energy within his body, attempting to break free, while letting out a disdainful laugh: "You come visiting in the dead of night, just to say this nonsense? If you want to take my life, why all the talk?" His voice was terrifyingly calm, as if discussing today's weather. "Or could it be... you also have something to ask of me?"

The black-clad figure seemed slightly startled, then let out a low laugh. That laughter echoed through the empty dungeon, carrying an indescribable and ambiguous meaning.

dialogue.content: "Interesting." The black-clad figure quietly praised. "Just as I expected, you are entirely different from those others." Before the words even finished, he slowly raised his hand, slender fingers reaching for the black cloth covering his face. "Since we share this fate, I'll let you see clearly—this face, you should have seen before."

text.content:
The black cloth fell.

Chen Ji's pupils contracted violently in an instant—the face revealed was aged yet gaunt, with wrinkles carved like knife marks, and eyes as deep as an abyss. Most terrifying was that the contours of that face, the trajectory of those brows and eyes, bore a startling seventy percent resemblance to a blurred image in Chen Ji's memory!

"You..." A hoarse sound emerged from Chen Ji's throat, but his mind exploded like thunder, and in that instant, countless fragments拼凑 together—the faded portrait in the ancestral hall, the torn page his father clutched tightly before death, and those words left unfinished until his final breath.

dialogue.content: "I see you've guessed." The old man smiled faintly, that smile containing too many complex emotions—relief, bitterness, hope, and a trace of imperceptible guilt. "Indeed, I am the previous master of the Tianji Record, and also... your great-grandfather, Chen Xuan."

text.content:
Chen Xuan.

This name was like a thunderclap, shattering all of Chen Ji's doubts and arrangements over the years. He should have known—the incomplete Tianji Record, that intangible bloodline pull, and that familiar yet sorrowful feeling whenever he used the foresight ability.

"Great-grandfather..." Chen Ji repeated in a murmur, his voice carrying a hint of mockery. "You've hidden deep enough indeed. Dead for so many years, yet still able to climb out of the grave to frighten your descendants?"

dialogue.content: The old man heard this and instead of getting angry, laughed cheerfully: "Good, good, what sharp-tongued youngster! This is indeed Chen family's blood!" He收起笑意, his gaze suddenly turning sharp. "But you should understand, I appear at this moment not for a reunion. The Tianji Record chose you, there must be a reason. And your next choice will determine the fate of the entire Tianqing Sect... even the entire cultivation world."

text.content:
Chen Ji scoffed coldly in his heart, though his face showed an appearance of accepting guidance with an open mind: "What guidance does great-grandfather have? Please speak directly." His tone was respectful, yet his eyes were chillingly cold—one ancestor dead for years, suddenly appearing to order him around, by what right?

The old man seemed to see through his thoughts, sighing softly: "I know you don't believe me. A hundred years ago, I too was this rebellious." He paused, his voice dropping lower. "But there are some things you must know—the Heavenly Eye has already set its sights on you."

choice.prompt: When Chen Xuan mentioned the 'Heavenly Eye,' this was an existence Chen Ji had never heard of. How should he deal with this sudden information?

choices.description: Temporarily suppress the doubts in your heart, and wait until this great-grandfather finishes speaking before making a decision. The value of information often lies in how one uses it after hearing it.
choices.visible_cost: Consuming time may expose more information to unknown entities
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key intelligence about the Heavenly Eye
choices.risk_hint: The other party may be intentionally guiding you toward a predetermined path

text.content: Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes, pressing the surging doubts down in his heart. He knew too well—rushing to deny would only miss the key. "Please speak." Two words, brief and restrained, yet caused a trace of approval to flash in Chen Xuan's eyes.

choices.description: What truth can spill from a dead man's mouth? Even if an ancestor, who knows if this isn't an illusion set up by some old monster?
choices.visible_cost: May anger the other party, losing the opportunity to obtain information
choices.visible_reward: Test the other party's cards, exposing their true intentions
choices.risk_hint: If the other party truly is the great-grandfather, this move may close the door to communication

text.content: Chen Ji let out a disdainful laugh: "Great-grandfather? Hmph, I'd like to ask, how did you old one climb out of the coffin?" His gaze was like a blade. "The Tianji Record has always only recognized living masters. This act of yours—is it to deceive this undutiful descendant, or to deceive heaven?"

choices.description: Regardless of who the opponent is, take the initiative first. The matter of the Heavenly Secrets Eye can wait. First clarify their intentions and leverage.
choices.visible_cost: Might seem overly calculating, leaving a bad impression on the other party
choices.visible_reward: Control the pace of dialogue, gain more negotiating leverage
choices.risk_hint: The other party might be dissatisfied with your probing attitude

text.content: Chen Ji didn't respond immediately. Instead, he tilted his head and offered a harmless smile: 'Since Ancestor knows even about the Heavenly Secrets Eye, surely you are well aware of my current predicament?' His tone was casual. 'This junior is foolish, but only wants to know one thing—did you come to save me, or to use me?'

dialogue.content: Chen Xuan observed Chen Ji's reaction, a sharp glint flashing in his eyes. He didn't seem surprised by any of the three attitudes, instead nodding slightly: 'Good, very good. That you can remain calm in this situation proves I didn't misjudge you.' He clasped his hands behind his back, his voice suddenly dropping low, 'The Heavenly Secrets Eye is the manifestation of Heavenly Will. It is not a specific person, but rather a... transcendent existence. Every prophet throughout history, including you and me, is merely a chess piece on its board.'

text.content:
Chen Ji's pupils contracted slightly. He had long sensed that every prophecy from the Tianji Record came with some indescribable cost, but he had never imagined something so terrifying lurked behind it all.

'So you back then...' He trailed off.

Chen Xuan gave a bitter laugh: 'Indeed, I was also a piece chosen and then discarded by it. Before I died, I passed the fragment into the Chen family, hoping that one day someone could break free from this dead-end game.' His gaze fell on Chen Ji, carrying complex emotions. 'And you... you are the variable I've waited a hundred years for.'

dialogue.content:
'Variable?' Chen Ji coldly snorted. 'You truly overestimate me, old one. Atrash at Foundation Building stage—what variable could I possibly be?'

Chen Xuan shook his head, his voice suddenly grave: 'You are wrong. The Tianji Record chose you not for your cultivation, but because of... the Heavenly Fate Key.' He paused, as if searching for the right words. 'Twin fated ones are about to appear. Between you and her, one will inherit the complete Tianji Record, while the other... will become the new container of the Heavenly Secrets Eye.'

text.content:
Heavenly Fate Key. Twin Fated Ones.

These two terms struck like a key, suddenly opening a long-sealed door in Chen Ji's heart. He remembered something—his missing sister, Chen Nian. Her face was always blurred in the Tianji Record's visions, as if deliberately obscured by some force.

'The twin fated ones you speak of...' Chen Ji's voice grew hoarse, something caught in his throat. 'Who are they?'

Chen Xuan fell silent for a moment, then softly said: 'You already have the answer in your heart, don't you?'

choice.prompt: Upon learning that Chen Nian might be one of the 'Twin Fated Ones', Chen Ji was deeply shaken. How should he face this truth that could change everything?

choices.description: Since we've already come this far, might as well get the complete truth—whose hands truly control Chen Nian's fate?
choices.visible_cost: Consuming energy, possibly touching the softest parts of the heart
choices.visible_reward: Obtain clues about how to save Chen Nian
choices.risk_hint: The truth might be crueler than imagined

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcibly suppressing the surging emotions. 'How do we break this situation?' His voice regained its composure, that chilling calm even drawing a sidelong glance from Chen Xuan. 'You've plotted for a hundred years, surely you didn't come merely to deliver this bad news.'

choices.description: Why? Why must my fate, Chen Ji's fate, be arranged by some Heavenly Will? Why must Chen Nian be dragged into this dead-end game?
choices.visible_cost: Might be seen as arrogant, attracting the Heavenly Secrets Eye's premature attention
choices.visible_reward: Display an unyielding will, gaining Chen Xuan's deeper recognition
choices.risk_hint: Going against heaven comes with incalculable costs
choices.process_label: laugh at fate, forge own path

text.content: Chen Ji猛地抬头，眼中闪过一抹刺骨的寒芒：'安排？'他的声音low而危险，'我陈机从不信命。天道要摆布我，我便掀了这棋盘。它想拿陈念做容器，我就先把它那狗屁眼睛挖出来！'

choices.description: 有些事，说出来只会显得自己软弱。真正的答案，要靠自己去寻找。
choices.visible_cost: 可能错失陈玄最后的指点
choices.visible_reward: Keep your trump card hidden, don't let the opponent see your weaknesses
choices.risk_hint: Chen Xuan might lose patience because of this

text.content: Chen Ji did not speak, merely gazing quietly at Chen Xuan. His eyes were calm like still water, fathomless, like an ancient well where no matter what stones you cast in, not even a ripple would appear. Looking into those eyes, Chen Xuan couldn't help but feel a chill—this child's depths of cunning ran even deeper than his own in youth.

dialogue.content: Gazing at Chen Ji for a moment, Chen Xuan suddenly let out a long sigh. His form began to fade, as if it might dissipate into the void at any moment. "Time is running out." His voice grew distant, "Tomorrow at noon, you will see him—the one chosen by the Eyes of Heavenly Dao, the one about to become the new vessel. Then, you will face a choice: to submit to heavenly fate, or..." He didn't finish, but in those aged eyes, a mixture of anticipation and determination flickered.

text.content: "Great-grandfather!" Chen Ji called out instinctively, his voice carrying rare urgency. He had too many questions to ask, too many schemes needing guidance—but Chen Xuan's form had already faded to near transparency, leaving only a wisp of remnant will drifting in the air. "Remember..." Chen Xuan's voice came from all directions, like a dying candle flame in the wind, "The more complete the Tianji Record... the stronger the fatal backlash of fate... you must..." The words cut off abruptly.

Countless specks of light burst forth from where Chen Xuan had dissolved, like a swarm of fireflies tracing splendid paths through the darkness. They circled Chen Ji for a moment, seeming to convey some warm yet sorrowful emotions, then receded like a tide, drifting toward the depths of the void. Only one tiny speck of light settled steadily in Chen Ji's palm, transforming into a line of scalding text—"Tomorrow at noon, you will see him." The light faded, the text vanished, leaving only the faintly reddened skin of his palm and the raging tempest ceaselessly churning in his heart.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji slowly opened his eyes. The dungeon's cold dampness wrapped around his body once more, the air thick with mold and blood. He looked down at his hands—intact, not even a trace of torture remaining. As if that conversation with his great-grandfather had been nothing but a bizarre dream. But he knew it was no dream. The residual warmth in his palm was gradually cooling with time, reminding him this was all real. "Eyes of Heavenly Dao... Twin of Destiny..." he murmured, a knowing smile suddenly curving his lips, "Interesting. More and more interesting."

choice.prompt: The mysterious conversation ended, and Chen Ji sat alone in the dungeon. He had to make a decision before dawn—whether the mysterious figure at noon tomorrow was friend or foe.

choices.description: Regardless of who it is, prepare first. If enemy, make sure they never leave; if ally, ensure you don't suffer losses either.
choices.visible_cost: Consuming massive energy to prepare may affect tomorrow's condition
choices.visible_reward: Grasp the initiative, secure a favorable position no matter who comes
choices.risk_hint: If the other party's strength far exceeds expectations, you might be checkmated

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, his fingers hidden in his sleeve quietly掐动. The Tianji Record fragment faintly heated in his mind, a blurry image emerging—tomorrow at noon, the small forest outside the dungeon, a vague human silhouette. He memorized that location and began silently calculating how to transform it into his own domain.

choices.description: Since they said they would come, why bother with extra steps? Better to conserve energy and adapt to whatever comes when you meet.
choices.visible_cost: Relinquish the initiative, may fall into a passive position
choices.visible_reward: Preserve strength, meet changes in optimal condition
choices.risk_hint: The other party might take the opportunity to set up, causing you to miss the first move

text.content: Chen Ji made no move, merely leaning against the wall, resting his eyes. His breathing gradually steadied, the spiritual energy in his body beginning to circulate slowly. The Tianji Record matter was too strange—he needed this final clarity to sort through all the information he'd gathered tonight—great-grandfather, Eyes of Heavenly Dao, Twin of Destiny, and that mysterious figure about to appear.

choices.description: Forget about fate's arrangement, let's get out of this wretched place first. The Tianqing Sect dungeon cannot hold Chen Ji.
choices.visible_cost: May alert the enemy, affecting tomorrow's meeting
choices.risk_hint: If captured again, tomorrow's variables will be completely out of control

text.content: Chen Ji rose quietly, his gaze sweeping across the prison door. He noticed the bars in the corner were slightly thinner than the others, corroded more severely as well. If he rammed with all his strength, there might be a chance to escape—but his fingers lingered on the bars for a moment before he ultimately pulled them back. "Not yet." he murmured softly, "There are more important things to do."

As night deepened, the torches in the dungeon crackled, stretching Chen Ji's lonely shadow long across the floor. He leaned against the corner wall, gazing at the narrow sliver of window above his head, yet his thoughts had already drifted a thousand miles away.

Chen Nian, where are you now?

His missing sister, the girl who had been inseparable from him since childhood. Her vague figure from the Tianji Record was now crystal clear in his mind. He remembered her as a child, tugging at his sleeve and calling out in her baby voice, "Brother"; remembered the day she was taken away, how he had hidden behind the door, fists clenched in powerless humiliation.

This was his greatest weakness in life, and also his greatest forbidden reverse scale.

Chen Ji slowly clenched his fist, his knuckles turning white.

"The Eye of Heavenly Secrets wants to use her as a vessel?" His voice was low and dangerous, echoing in the silent dungeon, "Then I'll make it unable to open its eyes."

The moonlight outside the window cast a line of silver radiance, illuminating his terrifyingly calm face. In those eyes, there was no anger, no sorrow—only an abyss of cold calculation.

From this moment on, another piece had been added to his chessboard—a piece he must save. Not for some heavenly fate, not for some mission, but simply because she was Chen Nian.

His sister.

The night was as dark as ink, the starlight dim.

Chen Ji sat quietly like this, waiting for dawn to arrive. In his mind, he continuously deduced all the possible situations that might occur tomorrow, weighing every possibility, every variable.

The fragment of the Tianji Record in his arms radiated gentle warmth, as if also anticipating the coming upheaval.

At noon tomorrow, the mysterious figure mentioned by his great-grandfather would appear. And Chen Ji knew that from that moment, he would officially step into a chess game far grander than he had imagined—one where even the Heavenly Dao would personally place its pieces.

"Bring it on." he whispered softly, a faint smile curling at the corner of his mouth, "Friend or foe, I'll face it all."
